title: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.13505v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific discovery increasingly requires AI systems that can reason over scientific evidence of heterogeneous modalities, interact with scientific tools and environments, and sustain progress across long task horizons. We present Intern-S2-Preview, a series of scientific agentic foundation models designed to support multimodal scientific understanding, reasoning, generation, and long-horizon tasks. The training pipeline begins with scientific multimodal pre-training over rendered scientific documents, interleaved image-text data, and diverse scientific corpora. Starting from the pretrained checkpoint, we apply a unified post-training pipeline consisting of supervised fine-tuning, scalable multi-task reinforcement learning (RL), black- and white-box agentic RL, and on-policy distillation. translated_abstract: 科学发现日益需要能够对异构模态的科学证据进行推理、与科学工具和环境互动、并在长时间任务跨度内持续取得进展的人工智能系统。我们提出了Intern-S2-Preview，一系列科学智能体基础模型，旨在支持多模态科学理解、推理、生成和长时间任务。训练流程始于对渲染后的科学文档、交错图像-文本数据和多样化科学语料库进行科学多模态预训练。从预训练检查点出发，我们应用了一个统一的后期训练流程，包括监督微调、可扩展的多任务强化学习（RL）、黑盒和白盒智能体RL，以及在线策略蒸馏。该流程得到了实用技术的支持，这些技术提高了 rollout 和训练稳定性及效率，包括部分 rollout 和离策略方法。
tldr: 本文提出了Intern-S2-Preview，一个科学智能体基础模型系列，通过统一的预训练和后期训练流程（包括多任务强化学习和智能体RL），实现了对多模态科学证据的推理、工具交互和长时间任务处理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Intern-S2-Preview, a series of scientific agentic foundation models that achieve multimodal scientific reasoning, tool interaction, and long-horizon task capabilities through a unified pre-training and post-training pipeline including multi-task RL and agentic RL.
